MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Monash Health exists to reimagine care, so that people can live their best lives. 


We provide safe and equitable care, for every stage of life, delivered with world-leading expertise and over 175 years of experience. 


As a leading academic health service, we're committed to providing tomorrow's care today by integrating research, teaching and training into everyday practice. 


Our team of 24,000 people are full hearted, open minded and all in. Together, we provide more than 250 integrated services for every stage of life at over 50 locations and in the community across south-east Melbourne, Victoria, serving 1.2 million residents in the South Metro Local Health Service Network. 


To see first-hand what our colleagues think about working here, take a look at the following short videos monashhealth.org-careers.

Shape digital learning experiences that meet clinicians where they are.



Great digital systems only deliver when the people using them are confident, capable and supported. This role is about bringing clinical digital learning to life - designing and delivering engaging, modern learning experiences that move our clinicians from system training to genuine digital capability.


As a Clinical Digital Learning Specialist, you'll be a key member of our newly established Clinical Digital Learning Practice within the Department of Clinical Informatics, turning our Clinical Digital Learning Framework into practical tools, content and experiences that clinicians value and use.


This is an exciting opportunity to help shape a new practice while making a direct, hands-on difference to how clinicians learn.




About The Role



Reporting to the Manager Clinical Digital Learning Practice, you'll design and implement innovative learning solutions aligned to the Clinical Digital Learning Framework, delivering scalable approaches that rapidly build digital capability and literacy across our clinical workforce.


Working within an agile, innovative team, you'll integrate clinical digital learning into onboarding, ongoing professional development and project and enhancement programs, and - where needed - help transition current training approaches into modern learning tools and resources. You'll collaborate closely with Clinical Change Specialists and Clinical Informaticians so that learning and change are aligned, and you'll provide learning expertise to projects as required.


Success in the role will be measured across three key areas:






Implementing clinical digital learning tools and resources


Collaboration with Clinical Informatics and Digital Change to support innovation and benefits realisation


Stakeholder engagement and trusted relationship development







This Full Time, ongoing role is based in our hybrid workplace, with at least three days each week on site and flexibility to work from home. Travel across Monash Health sites will be required.





About You



You understand that successful digital transformation is about people - not just technology. You're a learning practitioner who enjoys creating engaging, practical learning experiences and seeing them land in real clinical environments.


You bring strong design and delivery skills, an eye for the learner's experience, and the ability to make complex digital systems feel approachable. You build relationships easily, communicate clearly, and manage competing priorities with confidence.



You'll also bring:






Demonstrated success implementing organisational learning frameworks, tools and-or artefacts


Ability to undertake a Learning Needs Analysis, contribute to digital transformation, develop LMS content and design for learner experience


An understanding of the digital learning requirements needed to uplift digital literacy and capability


Extensive stakeholder engagement, partnership development and customer-focused service delivery


Capability in analytics-driven learning evaluation and reporting


Proven ability to manage time and prioritise effectively where deadlines compete


Certification or postgraduate qualifications in Education, Learning, Organisational Development, Instructional Design or equivalent (health qualifications will be highly regarded)










Why Join the Department of Clinical Informatics?



The Department of Clinical Informatics brings together clinical expertise, digital innovation and human-centred design to improve the way care is delivered across Monash Health.


Working alongside our Chief Nursing & Midwifery Information Officer and Chief Medical Information Officer, you'll join a collaborative multidisciplinary team focused on transforming healthcare through digital innovation, clinical engagement and continuous improvement.


You'll have the opportunity to help establish a new Clinical Digital Change Practice while working on initiatives that improve clinical workflows, patient safety and the experience of both clinicians and consumers






Why join Monash Health?



This is more than a digital role-it's your chance to transform healthcare at scale. Working at the intersection of clinical care, technology and innovation, you'll help create smarter digital solutions that improve patient outcomes and support the clinicians who deliver them every day




At Monash Health, you will:









Lead a state-wide service with real impact


Work within a values-driven, purpose-led organisation


Be part of a connected network of clinical, academic and system leaders


Help drive innovation, inclusion and better health outcomes











We also offer:









The opportunity to make a real impact on patient experience


A supportive, collaborative team environment


Ongoing learning and development opportunities


The chance to be part of Victoria's largest public health service
